Install and configure the privileged Rugix Ctrl daemon.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

| Name                   | Default | Description                                                      |
| ---------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `dangerously_insecure` | `false` | Bypass normal daemon authorization checks.                       |
| `factory_reset`        | `false` | Allow daemon clients to request a factory reset.                 |
| `system_commit`        | `false` | Allow daemon clients to commit a trial system.                   |
| `system_reboot`        | `false` | Allow daemon clients to reboot the system.                       |
| `app_lifecycle`        | `false` | Allow daemon clients to manage application lifecycle operations. |

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value        |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| Priority     | `100000`     |
| Dependencies | `rugix-ctrl` |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Requires systemd and a Rugix Ctrl release that provides daemon mode. The recipe
installs its service and access configuration. Each capability is disabled by
default; enable the operations required by the clients that will use the daemon.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/rugix-ctrl-daemon"]
```
